title: Spicy Ethiopian Kale Stir Fry with Azifa
description: A fusion dish combining traditional Ethiopian flavors with Chinese stir-fry techniques. Azifa adds a unique twist to this spicy kale recipe.

ingredients.name: Kale
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, stems removed and discarded, leaves coarsely chopped

instructions: In a large bowl, massage the chopped kale with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, until wilted.
Transfer the kale to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, until slightly caramelized.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the minced ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped Azifa and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly browned.
Add the roasted kale, Berbere Spice Mix, soy sauce, and garlic to the skillet.
Stir-fry everything together for 2-3 minutes, until the kale is well coated with the spice mix.
